result.title: RingCentral Scales Customer Programs with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
“ChatGPT Work helped me scale from six customers that I was tracking in the pilot phase to about 80.”

Vaneet Seth, R&D Efficiency Manager at RingCentral, uses ChatGPT Work to bring together information across siloed teams, turn scattered knowledge into a living operating system, and move from insights to execution faster.

Check out how ChatGPT Work can work for you: http://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/

result.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
result.description:
In this customer story, Jonathan Abrahamson, Chief Product & Digital Officer at Deutsche Telekom, shares how the company is reimagining telecommunications with AI—transforming employee workflows, customer service, network operations, and the future of voice.

Hear how Deutsche Telekom is working toward becoming an AI-native telecommunications company, bringing AI into communications experiences through capabilities such as live translation, in-call assistants, and automated summarization, while redesigning how work gets done across the business.

Read the full Deutsche Telekom story: https://openai.com/index/deutsche-telekom/
